blurb: Pine Acres is a member-owned facility, that has been operating in Wethersfield, Connecticut since 1957. Our family friendly environment offers a variety of recreational summer activities. Our club offers a championship swim team, tennis team, swim and tennis lessons and synchronize swimming for all ages. We also have a full basketball court, volleyball court and a snack bar.
